description: This file contains utility functions for processing tool descriptions, including whitespace normalization, summarization, and detection of documentation block starts.

methods.name: normalizeSummaryWhitespace
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in a string by replacing multiple whitespace characters with a single space and trimming.

methods.name: truncateSummary
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, attempting to cut at a word boundary, and appends ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: isToolDocBlockStart
methods.description: Checks if a line indicates the start of a tool documentation block based on specific keywords or formatting.

methods.name: summarizeToolDescriptionText
methods.description: Generates a summary of a tool description, prioritizing display summary, then raw description, with truncation.

methods.name: describeToolForVerbose
methods.description: Provides a verbose description of a tool, extracting relevant lines from raw description with length limits.
